Join us</a> <a aria-label="login as a mechanic" class="btn-md btn-block btn-tertiary btn-tertiary--bold btn-tertiary--transparent flex flex-center" href="/login" target="_self">Mechanics Login</a> </div> </div> <div class="ag-footer__logo"> <div class="small" id="logo-disclaimer"> Copyright 2019 AutoGuru Australia Pty Ltd </div> </div> <div class="ag-footer__social"> <ul> <li><a aria-label="facebook social media" href="https://www.facebook.com/AutoGuru.com.au/" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"><i class="ag-social-icon ag-social-icon--facebook"></i></a></li> <li><a aria-label="linkedin social media" href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/autoguru" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"><i class="ag-social-icon ag-social-icon--linkedin"></i></a></li> <li><a aria-label="instagram social media" href="https://www.instagram.com/autoguru.com.au/" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"><i class="ag-social-icon ag-social-icon--instagram"></i></a></li> <li><a aria-label="heap analytics social media" href="https://heapanalytics.com/?utm_source=badge" rel="nofollow"><img alt="Heap | Mobile and Web Analytics" class="lazyload" data-src="//heapanalytics.com/img/badge.png" style="width:108px;height:41px"/></a></li> </ul> </div> </div> </section> </main> <div class="sidebar-faq ag-sidenav-6626" id="help-nav"> <div> <div class="flex flex-center flex-align-edges m-3"> <div class="flex flex-column"> <h3 class="heading-small mb-0">Frequently Asked Questions</h3> <a class="text-bold flex flex-center mt-2 mb-0" href="tel:1300 655 661"><i class="material-icons icon-20 mr-1">phone</i>1300 655 661</a> </div> <a class="nav-close-trigger" id="help-close"> <i class="nav-close-dark pointer"></i> </a> </div> <div class="mb-5"> <div class="expander expander--faq"> <a class="expander-trigger expander-trigger--faq expander-hidden" href="javascript:void(0)"> Is the price quoted, the price I will pay? </a> <div class="expander-content"> <p> </p><p>Yes, the price quoted is the price you’ll pay. You won’t pay a cent more and you’ll get exactly what’s listed in the inclusions.</p> <p>And don’t worry, if there’s any additional work required, the mechanic will contact you and get your consent prior to starting.</p> <p></p> </div> </div><div class="expander expander--faq"> <a class="expander-trigger expander-trigger--faq expander-hidden" href="javascript:void(0)"> Can I change my service date? </a> <div class="expander-content"> <p> </p><p>Sure, we get that things pop up. Just call our friendly team on 1300 655 661 and we’ll happily reschedule your booking.</p> <p>There's no fee to reschedule your booking, however, if you’ve prepaid upfront on credit card, PayPal Afterpay or Zip and wish to cancel your booking altogether, you will be refunded the original booking fee paid, minus a $20 cancellation fee.</p> <p>Should you fail to show up at the time and place arranged with the Workshop without canceling in advance, you will forfeit the entire prepaid amount.</p> <p>For full details see <a href="https://www.autoguru.com.au/terms#refunds" rel="noopener" target="_blank">here</a></p> <p></p> </div> </div><div class="expander expander--faq"> <a class="expander-trigger expander-trigger--faq expander-hidden" href="javascript:void(0)"> Does the price include parts and labour? </a> <div class="expander-content"> <p> </p><p><span>For all servicing and repairs, our pricing includes parts, labour and GST.</span></p> <p><span>For inspection and diagnostic jobs, our pricing includes labour and GST but does not include parts.</span></p> <p></p> </div> </div><div class="expander expander--faq"> <a class="expander-trigger expander-trigger--faq expander-hidden" href="javascript:void(0)"> Is there a loan car available? </a> <div class="expander-content"> <p> </p><p>Some of our workshops do offer a loan car and/or a drop off/pick up service (up to 5km from the workshop).</p> <p>If the workshop is a Preferred Partner, these extras will be listed on the right hand side, underneath their pricing.</p> <p>If the workshop is not a Preferred Partner, click the ‘Book Now’ button and then click the ‘<em><strong>Add a Roadworthy, Pink Slip or other common tasks</strong></em>’ text underneath the inclusions box at the top of the page.</p> <p>Any additional services offered by the workshop will be included in this section.</p> <p></p> </div> </div><div class="expander expander--faq"> <a class="expander-trigger expander-trigger--faq expander-hidden" href="javascript:void(0)"> What's the difference between a basic service and a logbook service? </a> <div class="expander-content"> <p> </p><p>A basic service includes engine oil and engine oil filter change, as well as a general safety inspection and inspection of all fluids.</p> <p>If minor quantities of other fluids are required, the mechanic will top these up.</p> <p>A logbook service is a series of scheduled tasks recommended by the vehicle manufacturer at certain time intervals. Every logbook service is different. See the list of <strong>Service Tasks</strong> at the top of the booking confirmation page.</p> <p> </p> <p></p> </div> </div><div class="expander expander--faq"> <a class="expander-trigger expander-trigger--faq expander-hidden" href="javascript:void(0)"> Will the mechanic stamp my logbook? </a> <div class="expander-content"> <p> </p><p>Absolutely, the mechanic will sign and stamp your logbook to meet manufacturer requirements.</p> <p>They will sign off each task as it’s finished, and only stamp your logbook once all tasks specified by the manufacturer have been completed.</p> <p></p> </div> </div><div class="expander expander--faq"> <a class="expander-trigger expander-trigger--faq expander-hidden" href="javascript:void(0)"> Will my warranty be affected if I book with one of your mechanics rather than the dealership? </a> <div class="expander-content"> <p> </p><p>The Australian Competition &amp; Consumer Commission (ACCC) states that any certified mechanical workshop or mobile mechanic is indeed qualified to carry out logbook servicing as per manufacturer’s specifications, without voiding your New Car Manufacturers Warranty.</p> <p>Our mechanics are able to carry out logbook servicing, according to the manufacturer’s specifications, using quality parts and lubricants.</p> <p>The mechanic will sign off each item and stamp your logbook once all tasks are completed and your manufacturer's warranty will remain intact.</p> <p></p> </div> </div><div class="expander expander--faq"> <a class="expander-trigger expander-trigger--faq expander-hidden" href="javascript:void(0)"> Where can I find the inclusions for my service? </a> <div class="expander-content"> <p> </p><p>Once you’ve typed in all your details and submitted the quote request form, you’ll see a list of suitable mechanics in your area and their costs to carry out your car service.</p> <p>You can view all the inclusions for your service at the<strong> top of the page </strong>under <strong>Service Tasks</strong>. This is found directly underneath the name of the service you have chosen.</p> <p></p> </div> </div><div class="expander expander--faq"> <a class="expander-trigger expander-trigger--faq expander-hidden" href="javascript:void(0)"> Can the mechanic come to me? </a> <div class="expander-content"> <p> </p><p>Yes! Our network of mobile mechanics can come to your home or workplace to carry out vehicle inspections, car servicing and some minor repairs.</p> <p>Go through the search process and when you come to the page listing mechanics in your area, mobile mechanics in your area will be listed along with workshops. <br/><br/>Their listing will have a special Mobile Mechanic badge which can be found directly underneath their operating hours. </p> <p></p> </div> </div><div class="expander expander--faq"> <a class="expander-trigger expander-trigger--faq expander-hidden" href="javascript:void(0)"> Can I get quotes for repairs and inspections? </a> <div class="expander-content"> <p> </p><p>You sure can! Once you have entered in your vehicle details and location on the home screen, the next page will ask you what repair or service you're after.</p> <p>You can browse through the categories that we've listed, such as <em><strong>Brakes, Clutch or Timing belt/chain</strong>, or by clicking the blue <strong>"Search repairs &amp; inspections"</strong> </em>button<strong> </strong>at the bottom of the page, you can search for the repair you're after. <em><br/><br/></em>If you're still unable to find what you're after, click on the blue <em><strong>"Can't find it? We can help!" </strong></em>button and you'll be provided with a comment box where you can describe the repair you need. </p> <p>Once you've selected a repair, either click <em><strong>"Continue" </strong></em>to move on in the quote process or, If you'd like to add another repair, click the <em><strong>"Add more items" </strong></em>button. </p> <p></p> </div> </div><div class="expander expander--faq"> <a class="expander-trigger expander-trigger--faq expander-hidden" href="javascript:void(0)"> What are my payment options? </a> <div class="expander-content"> <p> </p><p>Booking through AutoGuru gives you access to three payment options:</p> <p>1. Pay upfront and online using your credit card or PayPal<br/>2. Create an Afterpay account that allows you to pay now and make four, fortnightly interest-free payments<br/>3. Pay the workshop when you pick your car up and the service and/or repairs have been completed </p> <p>Cancellation fees apply. For full Terms &amp; Conditions visit <a href="https://www.autoguru.com.au/terms" rel="noopener" target="_blank">https://www.autoguru.com.au/terms</a></p> <p></p> </div> </div><div class="expander expander--faq"> <a class="expander-trigger expander-trigger--faq expander-hidden" href="javascript:void(0)"> What’s included in my service? </a> <div class="expander-content"> <p> </p><p>Once you’ve typed in all your details and submitted the quote request form, you’ll see a list of trusted mechanics in your area and their costs to carry out your car service.</p> <p>You can view all the inclusions for your service at the top of the page under <em><strong>"Service Tasks"</strong></em>. This is located directly underneath the name and price of the service you've selected. </p> <p></p> </div> </div> </div> </div> <style type="text/css"></style></div> <script type="application/ld+json">
